rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act – Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources with notice to quit
rules.requirement: Any landlord ending a tenancy must give the tenant a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources at the same time as the notice to quit or notice of non-renewal. Landlords and foreclosing owners must also file the notice to quit or non-renewal, with tenant contact information, through the City's online portal.
rules.key_value: Notice required with every notice to quit/non-renewal; fine up to $300/day
rules.coverage_conditions: All landlords in Boston planning to end a tenancy agreement, and foreclosing owners for the city filing requirement.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only when a landlord is ending a tenancy, through a notice to quit or a notice of non-renewal.

rules.penalty: Enforced by Inspectional Services: warning for the 1st offense, $300 per day for the 2nd and later offenses. A violation does not halt the eviction process.
rules.citation: City of Boston Ordinances Sec. 10-11.7 (Housing Stability Notification Act)
rules.quoted_span: The Housing Stability Notification Act requires any landlord to provide renters with a Notice of Tenant’s Rights and Resources when planning to end a tenancy agreement.
rules.conflict_note: This is a notice and filing requirement, not a just-cause standard. It does not limit the grounds for eviction, and violations do not halt the eviction. It is classified under just_cause_eviction as the closest category. The page gives no effective date. Sec. 10-11.7 appears in the page's penalty listing and may be the enforcement section rather than the ordinance's own codification.
